Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: C01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Ingestion engineer and source curator

Outcome: Only the advertised source installation and acquisition profiles are claimed as qualified.

Acceptance:
- Survey the named XNAT installation/resources and/or DICOM collection, preserve restricted evidence, specify mappings and independent scientific fixtures, and record exclusions.
- Rehearse interruption, source/output accounting and final reconciliation with the real permitted collection; conversion success alone is insufficient.
- When SITE01 selects this source for beta, make this item a blocking program dependency; otherwise keep it distinct from native-BIDS beta and retain original migration-pilot obligations.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/import-xnat/src/main/scala/sanctity/xnat/XnatApi.scala
- modules/import-dicom/src/main/scala/sanctity/dicom/DicomImport.scala
- docs/prd.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: C01: Qualify the selected DICOM or XNAT source when adoption requires it
